_readme: Operator control panel. Edit this file (GitHub web or mobile is fine) to pause or steer the agents. Every agent reads it first and obeys it. HOW OFTEN each agent runs is set on its routine schedule at https://claude.ai/code/routines, not here.
focus: LOCKDOWN (set 2026-10-21 by the operator). Production quality on phone, iPad and desktop before any new features. Work the by: operator tickets 0033-0054 in priority order (P0 first, then lowest id): flicker, layout at every viewport (iPad and safe-area insets included), input on every device, lifecycle (pause/background/return), resilience (no leaks, no stale starts, no reload into an offline page, deadlines on every network call), frame pacing and battery. Every PR must leave hud-audit and title-audit clean and must not raise any flicker.mjs region (docs/flicker-budget.json once 0050 lands). A ticket marked in-progress belongs to someone else: skip it. Realism tickets wait until the lockdown P0s and P1s are shipped; new tickets from the Scout and Critic must serve the lockdown (stability, polish, platform, performance), not new features. Keep: determinism, 32/32 naive landings, no brand names.
